mainEntity.name: How does it differ from lip filler?

acceptedAnswer.text: LipLase plumps through the patient's own collagen response, stimulated by controlled laser pulses on and around the lip area. It does not add volume the way filler does — the change is more subtle, more gradual, and entirely needle-free. Many patients combine both for synergy.

mainEntity.name: When will I see the plumping effect?

acceptedAnswer.text: There is a small immediate plumping right after the session that subsides in hours. The lasting effect develops over several weeks as collagen reorganises. After the full protocol you should see softer lines, better hydration and a fuller appearance. Results typically last several months and improve with maintenance.

There is a warm sensation during the laser pulses and a slight tingling on the lips after. Most patients describe it as comfortable and quick. We apply hydrating balm right after the session and you can resume your routine immediately.

hero.title: Fotona LipLase in Miami
hero.lede: LipLase uses Fotona Er:YAG and Nd:YAG energy on and around the lips to stimulate collagen, increase hydration and produce visibly fuller, smoother lips without filler.

blocks.title: What it does for you
list: Plumps the lips through collagen stimulation, without injecting hyaluronic acid.
Softens vertical perioral lines (smoker's lines) around the mouth.
Improves lip texture, hydration and definition of the lip border (vermilion).
Each session lasts about 30 minutes; protocol typically 3–4 sessions spaced 3–4 weeks apart.
Ideal for patients who want lip enhancement without injectables or as a complement to filler.
No needles, no downtime — patients return to normal activity the same day.
